title: Make switching to the manager tab as quick as a project tab
notes: Measured: Ctrl+1 is 88-184 ms input-to-paint vs 24-72 ms for project tabs; handler 27-37 ms. Where: src/renderer/manager/manager-view.ts:492 list.replaceChildren every render, each row reading the live xterm buffer. Fix (small): build rows once, update changed ones. Rerun: measure.mjs keys. From profiling card dca04e6f, docs/performance/history.md 2026-11-02.

comments.body: From main-dashboard: measure before and after (CPU or frame time, or switch latency for the tab card), and put the numbers in the PR. Fix it at the root. Tests must be Windows-safe. Do not bump the version.
Pull request #314 opened: Keep the manager's rows between draws, so Ctrl+1 stops rebuilding the page https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/pull/314

PR #314. Rows are now kept between draws. Ctrl+1 median went 88 to 80 ms and the handler 29-30 to 21-23 ms; Ctrl+2 to alpha stayed at 48 ms. Parity is not reached: the GPU re-rasters the manager's text on each arrival (~16 ms) because hidden pages lose their tiles. Keeping the manager painted while hidden brought Ctrl+1 to 56 ms but alpha to 56 ms, so that is a separate decision, written up in docs/performance/history.md.
